review_scope: Read-only scientific protocol review before control generation. No generator, optimizer, target payload, fitted counts or native interpretation inspected. Not an implementation audit.

Unrestricted22-weight starts plus fully evaluated offset do not use the planted key or supplied rival shortlist. Exact key equality is separate from message equality and observable-key ambiguity.

interpretation_limits: The positive source fragments come from actual held corpus suffixes, not necessarily draws from the fitted Markov mixture; a higher-likelihood wrong decode may reflect finite-message ambiguity or source-model mismatch, and does not refute the writer.

A returned score below the true-key score proves the search missed at least that candidate; it does not locate the global optimum. Equal-score different plaintexts must be preserved as ambiguity, not silently resolved using truth.

Shuffled controls are informative negatives, but no numerical native classifier is calibrated by these six cases. Protocol correctly defers any pilot decision and forbids learning a native threshold from this control block.

Missing or dependent weights may be observationally unidentifiable in short messages. Exact-message success is therefore not proof of full-key identification.

material_execution_requirements: Do not inspect true keys or source fragments while choosing starts, stopping rules, representative outputs or engineering repairs. Freeze recovery outputs before truth release.
Benchmark must include the actual complete orbit/source evaluation cost and conservatively account for total proposed work. A runtime stop is a computational result, not failed scientific recovery.
Ensure source-boundary sampling and nonoverlap are deterministic given the sealed generator seed; do not resample negatives or awkward controls.
